page.overview:
Who is Barthie?

is an Elder of the Bormodo village of Razora on Ruidus; his cytaa is Chu. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Barthie walks with the aid of a long gnarled stick he leans on. He has long, stringy gray-white hair, deep wrinkles, and deep-set eyes. When he smiles, his intense expression melts into grandfatherly warmth.

Barthie bonded with Chu when the cytaa was young, and they have stayed together ever since, taking care of each other. Around 803 PD the bormodo visited Kreviris, the capital of the Imperium. In recent times he has had contact with the Volition, and it is strongly implied he may be a member or at least a collaborator.

In 843 PD Barthie shared much information about the history and philosophy of the inhabitants of Ruidus with Bells Hells, after Dono introduced them to him. After a long conversation in which both parties learned about their respective worlds (and during which the Elder confirmed that Otohan Thull and Ludinus Da'leth had been seen in the area weeks before) Barthie (despite Chu's caution) expressed willingness to help the adventurers meet Zhesh, an agent of the Volition, but before they could do so Willmaster Edmuda arrived at his house and a battle ensued.
